effects.description: Every visual effect: hit sparks, smoke, fire

name.description: The name of the effect; rules and weapons use it

frames.description: How many pictures the effect has (they must match the frames cut for it)

ticksPerFrame.description: Game ticks (20 a second) each picture stays on screen

loop.description: true: the effect plays again and again (a campfire); false: once

light.description: A kind of light of lights.json the effect gives while it plays
